title: 第二十五章 三十万公第二十六章 少年呼延赞博彩第四弹 上
content_zh:
黄昏时分，趁着浴室上晒得水还滚烫，陆宁舒舒服服冲了个澡，尔后穿着令裁缝特制的睡衣，进了书房，这明湖别苑的书房，虽然还有席，但却摆上了后边有斜靠背的软榻，类似比较低矮的沙发，席上则铺着软绵绵的兽皮，这样靠坐在软榻上，或读或写，就舒服多了。
陆宁拿着毛笔，正在写准备给学馆用的第二阶段的教材。
第一阶段的教材，陆宁已经定稿，除了识字以外，就是简单的算术。
而第二阶段，陆宁准备录入一些简单的天文地理自然知识，当然，不能太超越这个时代，而是按照现在人们的观念，略微向前进一小步，就算住的大地是球体，围绕太阳转这种简单的常识，都不可能录入，不然只会引起恐慌，甚至招来文人们的攻击和祸端。
准备大量招收学员的学馆，正在筹备，而且，陆宁准备强迫自己家佃农子女们，六岁后，十岁前，必须进私塾，若不用这种非常手段，估计也招不到几个学生。
当然，十岁以后，很多佃农家都将子女当半个劳力用了，那时候，就凭自愿了，总不能就可着自己的心情，根本不管现实情况乱搞，不然非天怒人怨不可。
非佃户的子女，如果要来自己的私塾，那也欢迎，当然，那就需要交学费了。
这个主意刚提出来，甘二郎及一些胥吏差役就都给子女报了名，而且，都缴了学费。
当然不是他们对子女有什么远大的期望或者认为国主第下编审的教材能点石成金，怎么看，国主第下也不是文人，他编审的书经，也不像能给孩子们提供光明的前途不是？
以前的县经学博士马竼化，现在的东海国学倌令，对未来学馆生员教授什么，好像已经完全插不上话，全凭国主第下做主。
不过，国主第下越是搞不靠谱的事业，越需要人支持，不然国主第下办的学馆，收费的名额，根本无人问津，那国主第下的心情肯定就不怎么美丽，国主第下心情不美丽，他们的日子，还能好过的了吗？
学馆什么时候重新开馆还没着落呢，早早就收了十几个孩童的学费预付款，陆宁编审教材的劲头就更足。
虽然知道那些家伙，这是在交保护费呢，但想来你们以后不会后悔。
门被轻轻叩响。
尤五娘的声音：“主君，是奴，五儿。”
“进来吧。”陆宁话音刚落，尤五娘推门而入，她显然也是刚沐浴过，头发湿漉漉的，但还是极为精致的盘成高高美髻，一袭浅红丝绸袄裤，粉色绣花鞋，很轻便，更显娇俏可人。
尤五娘的这一身丝绸衣裤，也是陆宁令一名女裁缝按他给的图样裁剪而成，给尤五娘和甘氏各做了几身，玫瑰花盘扣，开在袄的侧方，和后世复古衣服开扣方法一样，盘扣精美，显得甚为诱人，更凸显尤五娘小腰肢盈盈一握和迷人高song组合的玲珑身子曲线。
不过，便是尤五娘，这种新式衣裤也只在内宅穿，算是只有陆宁才能看到的福利。
虽然不知道主君为什么喜欢胡服，但在内宅当常服也不错，穿起来确实轻便方便。
还是不用动手，尤五娘用灵巧玉足褪去鞋袜，将各种时令水果切成的果盘放在桌上，这才跪坐在了矮桌对面。

其实陆宁本来是在矮桌对面也想放这种软榻沙发的，但却遭到了无声的抗议，尤五娘也好，甘氏也好，从来不会在对面坐下，却是开始跪坐在桌侧，显然，和主家面对面坐着，太没礼仪，和她们从小受的教育格格不入。
无奈下，陆宁只好撤去了对面的软榻沙发。
“生态平衡……”水汪汪凤目瞄着桌上的书册，尤五娘好奇的念叨。
说起来，尤五娘和尤老三本来也是淮南大户出身，因为战乱逃来了东海，家里亲人也不知道是死是活流落何方，但尤老三和尤五娘，自小都学过认字。
陆宁笑笑，就将书册转个方向，说：“你看看，能看得懂不？”如果尤五娘能看懂的内容，孩童们到了学习第二阶段，应该能够理解。
学馆的事情，陆宁准备交给尤五娘处理。
说起来也是令陆宁颇感无奈，本以为，甘氏和尤五娘两个人中，肯定是尤五娘适合经商，办学之类的想法，陆宁最早是想叫甘氏来办。
却不想，那天竞拍筹备大会交给甘氏和尤五娘两个人的作业，甘氏洋洋洒洒，颇有心得，这尤五娘，简直就是个糊涂蛋，乱写一通，显然根本就没看明白自己在搞的竞拍大会要做什么。
她竟然写什么，自己想结交东都留守，所以才大出血，不但送上百贯钱，还送上金丹。
显然，根本没认真听自己说什么，不定又开小差琢磨什么呢，多半就是珠宝美不美之类的。
陆宁当时看得都要抓狂。
商业的事情，不消说，要甘夫人幕后操办了，而办私塾，就只能交给尤五娘。
想想她来当这个东海国的幕后教育部长，陆宁又有些胆战心惊，真不知道，她会不会鼓捣出大事来。
“主君的肥料发酵池，收了许多野草，又用黍米茎叶，这就是，暗含生态平衡之道吧？”看完书册里陆宁写的生态平衡的条目，尤五娘眨着水汪汪凤目，好奇的问。
陆宁一呆，上下打量着尤五娘，一时无语。
尤五娘就有些惶惶，垂下头，小声说：“奴，奴说错了，请主君责打……”
“不，不，你说的很对，我现在，是真不知道你到底是愚笨还是聪明了！”陆宁长长叹口气。
尤五娘俏脸立时浮现甜甜笑容，“在主人面前，奴好像也开窍了！主人有仙气，奴跟着鸡犬升天！”
content_en:
At dusk, while the water in the bathroom was still hot from the sun, Lu Ning took a comfortable shower, then put on pajamas specially made by a tailor, and entered the study. Although there were seats in the study in Minghu Villa, there was a soft couch with reclining backrests at the back, similar to a relatively low sofa. The seats were covered with soft animal skins, so it was much more comfortable to sit on the soft couch while reading or writing.
Lu Ning was holding a writing brush and was writing the second-stage teaching materials for the academy.
Lu Ning has finalized the teaching materials for the first stage. In addition to literacy, it is simple arithmetic.
In the second stage, Lu Ning planned to enter some simple astronomical, geographical and natural knowledge. Of course, it should not be too far ahead of this era. Instead, it should be a small step forward according to the current people's concepts. Even if the earth is a sphere and it revolves around the sun, it is impossible to enter such simple common sense. Otherwise, it will only cause panic and even attract attacks and disasters from the literati.
A school that is going to recruit a large number of students is being prepared. Moreover, Lu Ning is planning to force the children of his sharecroppers to attend private schools after they are six years old and before they are ten years old. If such extraordinary measures are not used, it is estimated that there will not be many students recruited.
Of course, after the age of ten, many sharecropping families use their children as part of their labor force. At that time, it is a matter of volition. You cannot just follow your own mood and ignore the actual situation, otherwise you will be angry.
If the children of non-tenants want to come to their own private schools, they are welcome, but of course, they will need to pay tuition.
As soon as this idea was proposed, Gan Erlang and some subordinate officials and servants registered their children and paid the tuition fees.
Of course, it's not that they have any lofty expectations for their children or think that the textbooks compiled and reviewed by Guozhu Dixia can turn stone into gold. No matter how you look at it, Guozhu Dixia is not a literati, and the books he compiles and reviews don't seem to be able to provide children with a bright future, right?
The former county doctor of economics, Ma Langhua, and now the Donghai Chinese Studies Director, seem to have no say at all in what they teach to the students of the future academy, and it all depends on the ruler of the country.
However, the more unreliable the country's leader is, the more support he needs from people. Otherwise, if no one pays attention to the tuition fees for the school run by the country's leader, then the country's leader's mood will definitely not be very beautiful. If the country's leader is not in a beautiful mood, can their life be easy?
It's not clear when the school will reopen. Lu Ning has already collected tuition advances from a dozen children, and Lu Ning is even more motivated to compile and review teaching materials.
Although I know those guys are paying protection fees, I think you won't regret it in the future.
There was a gentle knock on the door.
You Wuniang's voice: "Master, this is your slave, Wu'er."
"Come in." As soon as Lu Ning finished speaking, You Wuniang pushed open the door and walked in. She had obviously just taken a shower, her hair was wet, but it was still very delicately tied into a high bun. She wore a light red silk jacket and trousers, and pink embroidered shoes, which were very light and made her look more delicate and charming.
You Wuniang's suit of silk clothes was also made by Lu Ning by a seamstress according to the pattern he gave him. He made several suits for You Wuniang and Gan respectively. The rosette buttons were slit on the side of the coat. The buttoning method is the same as that of later generations of retro clothes. The buttons are exquisite and look very attractive. They also highlight the exquisite body curves of You Wuniang's small waist and charming high song.
However, even You Wuniang can only wear this new style of clothes at home, which is a benefit that only Lu Ning can see.
Although I don’t know why the master likes Hufu, it is also good as daily clothes in the house, and it is indeed light and convenient to wear.
Still without using her hands, You Wuniang took off her shoes and socks with her dexterous feet, placed a fruit plate with various seasonal fruits on the table, and then knelt down opposite the low table.
In fact, Lu Ning originally wanted to place this kind of soft sofa opposite the low table, but he met with silent protests. Neither You Wuniang nor Gan would ever place it opposite the low table.They sat down in front of each other, but started to kneel down at the table. Obviously, sitting face to face with the host family was too rude and incompatible with the education they had received since childhood.
In desperation, Lu Ning had no choice but to remove the soft sofa opposite.
"Ecological balance..." You Wuniang muttered curiously, looking at the books on the table with watery eyes.
Speaking of which, You Wuniang and You Laosan originally came from a wealthy family in Huainan. They fled to the East China Sea because of the war. Their relatives at home did not know where they were living or dead. However, You Laosan and You Wuniang had both learned to read since they were young.
Lu Ning smiled, turned the book around and said, "Look, can you understand it?" If You Wuniang can understand the content, children should be able to understand it when they reach the second stage of learning.
Lu Ning was going to leave the school matters to You Wuniang.
Speaking of which, Lu Ning felt quite helpless. He thought that among the two people, Gan and You Wuniang, You Wuniang must be the one suitable for business and running a school. Lu Ning originally wanted to ask Gan to run it.
However, she didn't expect that the homework given to Gan and You Wuniang in the auction preparatory meeting that day was very eloquent and insightful. This You Wuniang was just a fool. She scribbled all over and obviously didn't understand what the auction meeting she was doing was going to do.
What did she actually write? She wanted to make friends with Dongdu Liushou, so she shed a lot of money and not only sent hundreds of dollars, but also golden elixirs.
Obviously, he didn't listen carefully to what he said, and he might have wandered off to think about something, probably whether the jewelry was beautiful or not.
Lu Ning was going crazy when he saw it.
Needless to say, Mrs. Gan took care of the business affairs behind the scenes, while running the private school could only be left to You Wuniang.
Thinking about her becoming the behind-the-scenes education minister of this East China Sea country, Lu Ning was a little frightened. He really didn't know if she would stir up big things.
"The master's fertilizer fermentation tank collects many wild grasses and uses millet stems and leaves. Does this imply the method of ecological balance?" After reading the ecological balance entry written by Lu Ning in the book, You Wuniang blinked her watery eyes and asked curiously.
Lu Ning was stunned and looked at You Wuniang up and down, speechless for a moment.
You Wuniang was a little panicked, lowered her head, and whispered: "Slave, I made a mistake, please punish me..."
"No, no, you are right. Now, I really don't know whether you are stupid or smart!" Lu Ning let out a long sigh.
A sweet smile immediately appeared on You Wuniang's pretty face, "In front of the master, the slave seems to have enlightened himself! The master has the spirit of immortality, and the slave follows the chicken and dog to heaven!"
